name: Gamer Stories ~Jitsuzai Suru Josei Gamer to Date Shite Mita~
original_name: Gamer Stories 〜実在する女性ゲーマーとデートしてみた〜
source:
This is a game where you can date real Japanese female gamers. Through dates, you can learn about each character's actual life experiences and hardships, getting to know them deeply. All of them share the common trait of being gamers, so you, who love games, will have lively conversations with them.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3077180/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一款可以与真正的日本女性玩家约会的游戏。通过约会，你可以了解每个角色的实际生活经历和艰辛，深入了解他们。他们都有着游戏玩家的共同特点，所以热爱游戏的你一定会和他们聊得热火朝天。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3077180/]Steam[/url]]
